chunks: ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah narrated from Zurārah from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about breastfeeding, and he said: “Breastfeeding does not create prohibition except that which was suckled from one breast for two complete years.”

key_terms.الرَّضَاعِ: breastfeeding or suckling that may establish milk-kinship
key_terms.ثَدْيٍ: breast from which the child suckled

ai.seo_question: When does breastfeeding create a marriage prohibition in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about when breastfeeding establishes a prohibitive kinship relation. It restricts the effect of radaʿ to a specific form and duration of nursing, indicating precise conditions in family law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4674 - Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated from Zurarah from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:

I asked him about breastfeeding, and Imam (as) said:
"Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except when a child nurses from one breast for two complete years."
